findings: The module has no top-level application import or external call when loaded under a non-main module name; top-level setup is definitions and finite constants.

The reviewed _build path creates one exclusive permanent artifact reservation and a new timestamped archive. It does not run AUTH, inference, Git, the native application or the historical source campaign.
The closed archive is fsynced and every manifest member is read back by exact size and SHA-256 before publishing its checksum atomically.
Existing return archives and reservations are not overwritten; a failed or pending build does not authorize a retry.
The delivery wait reads only the matching local delivery receipt and exact destination pair for at most thirty seconds. Missing delivery is reported as unconfirmed, not as successful delivery.

The generic builder consumes already prepared payload bytes; the separately reviewed caller must validate finite archive paths, exclusions, exact raw input pins and private-field policy before creating a reservation.
